High Court Of Andhra Pradesh::
 Amaravathi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and also learned Government Pleader for Roads and Buildings, placed a copy of the written instructions dated 03.11.2023 received from the 3rd respondent for perusal of this Court.

2. The writ petition is filed seeking to declare the action of the respondent Nos.2 to 4 in interfering with the land in an extent of Ac.1.84 cents in Sy.No.520/2 and Ac.3.100 cents in Sy.No.523/2 of Kuppam Village, Chakarayapeta Mandal, Y.S.R District, for the purpose of laying road from Merusupalle Cross- Kuppam Rasapalli Bridge-Kalluru Village cross under MDR-34 without initiating the proceedings under the provisions of the Right of Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013, as illegal, arbitrary and consequential directions not to lay road through the said land without initiating the proceedings under the Act.

entities.text: Right of Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner with reference to the averments made in the writ petition and the material placed along with the same in Ex.P1, made his submissions to the effect that the respondent authorities are highhandedly interfering with the possession and enjoyment of the Bommadi Subba Reddy vs The State Of Ap on 6 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70855411/
1 subject matter property, which is in possession of the petitioner, without following the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013.

entities.text: Bommadi Subba Reddy vs The State Of Ap
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
4. The submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, needs no detailed examination,
more particularly, in the light of the instructions referred to above which goes to show that certain extent of land of the petitioner is required for the purpose of laying the road and land acquisition proposals with regard to the same were submitted to the District Collector.

In the said instructions,
it is specifically stated that the provisions of the Act, 2013 would be strictly adhered to.

5. In view of the same and placing the instructions dated 03.11.2023 on record, the Writ Petition is disposed of providing that no coercive action in respect of the subject matter property without following the due process of law shall be resorted to.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.

_ _ JUSTICE NINALA JAYASURYA Date: 06.11.2023 SPP/KSJ THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE NINALA JAYASURYA WRIT PETITION No.28765 OF 2010 Date:
